content: Ghana is facing an environmental crisis where illegal mining is destroying our forests, river bodies and causing birth defects, kidney problems and other organ failures. We can not continue to trade our health for gold. We must unite to fight against Galamsey. #StopGalamseyNow

First part of ‘chant to the pits’. check out the full on YouTube. Illegal mining, aka galamsey is a menace and we shouldn’t stop the fight. You might not be a part of the problem but trust, the repercussions will embrace you. Tightly.
